<thought>We will search the template catalog for a template that matches the Doebner modification forward reaction: an aromatic aldehyde + malonic acid -> α,β‑unsaturated carboxylic acid. The target product is trans‑cinnamic acid (SMILES O=C(O)/C=C/c1ccccc1). We look for templates that break a C–O bond (aldehyde) and form a C=C bond, with bond order change from single to double on the carbon‑carbon bond. We'll use search_template_catalog_by_criteria with appropriate criteria.
